synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Scavengers Another Sky
titleNative: スカバンジャーズ アナザースカイ
synopsis: In a hidden research facility known as the “Bus Stop,” a fearless crew of treasure hunters — Scavengers — embarks on dangerous missions into the Black Parade, a mysterious parallel world filled with untold riches. Their mission: to gather valuable loot and earn a million dollars for their freedom. But there’s a deadly twist. The Black Parade is home to a vengeful entity determined to protect its treasures at any cost. With weapons drawn, the Scavengers face high-octane action, paranormal threats, and mind-bending mysteries in this thrilling sci-fi adventure. As they explore an eerie world full of bizarre creatures and unexplainable forces, they must rely on their wits, weapons, and teamwork to survive. But the deeper they go, the more they realize that the true cost of their mission might be more than they ever expected. (Source: Titan Manga) Note: The one-shot got published on July 20th, 2022 on the magazine Young Champion Retsu, and due to the popularity of this work, it was decided to serialize it. The one-shot was numbered as the first chapter of the manga, and the first chapter of the serialization got numbered as the second chapter of the series.

synopsis: Kotaro is an average young boy, and like many kids his age, he enjoys the latest childhood craze of playing with slime. One day, the slime randomly turns into an adorable girl who he names Puniru. Though cute, her stubbornness and constant need for attention get on his nerves. It’s like having a goopy little sister! Just when the two settle into their not-so-normal life, the granddaughter of Kyuthi Land’s founder arrives. Can Okanega Alice and her little friend Runrune out-cute the world’s most adorable slime girl?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
